summary: Iter44: Verified pending VA feature gating end-to-end. Backend: 24/24 pytest passed — pending VA gets 403 on /api/va/leads, /api/va/leads/{id}, /api/va/earnings, /api/va/commercial-accounts, /api/messages/threads, /api/messages/unread-count, POST /api/va/leads, and 200 on /api/va/dashboard, /api/va/templates, /api/va/leaderboard, /api/va/me. Approved VA still 200 on all 12 endpoints (no regression). Admin messaging endpoints (threads, unread-count, eligible-users, DM create) all return 200 — no regression from block_unapproved_va swap. Frontend: pending VA sidebar shows exactly 4 tabs (Dashboard, Leaderboard, Templates, Training); the 4 locked tab data-testids are absent in both desktop and mobile drawer. Locked URLs (/va/submit, /va/leads, /va/earnings, /va/messages) render va-locked-placeholder with correct featureLabel. All 3 CTAs (Training, Templates, Leaderboard) present and Training CTA navigates correctly. Yellow va-status-banner copy contains the new sentence verbatim. Approved VA sees all 8 tabs, no banner, and locked routes render real pages (not placeholder). Mobile drawer at 390x844 correctly filters to 4 tabs only.
critical_code_review_comments: VAApprovedGuard correctly uses defense-in-depth: route-level gating + sidebar filter — good pattern.
block_unapproved_va dep in va_commission.py is well-scoped; only blocks VAs whose status != approved, lets all other roles pass through.

VALayout filters tabs via approved===true (strict equality on va_status). Edge case: if backend ever returned va_status='approved ' with whitespace or different casing, tabs would hide. Currently fine because backend stores literal 'approved'.
Suspended VAs fall into the same locked-tab UX as pending — locked placeholder shows different copy via isSuspended branch, which is correct.
